title: Global Tech Recruiter Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Tech Recruiter Pleno em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a Mid-Level International Recruiter to join the Talent Acquisition team, focusing on global hiring for AI/R Company. Companies such as Avenue Code, Invillia, and Compass UOL are part of the group.

We are seeking a professional with an ownership mindset , resilience, and a strong consultative approach to join the team. You will be responsible for managing high-complexity roles in competitive markets, acting as a strategic partner to our clients and international leadership.

Nice to have:

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior - Protheus
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior - Protheus em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Buscamos um Analista de Desenvolvimento Sênior III com sólido domínio no ecossistema TOTVS Protheus para atuar em projetos estratégicos de alta complexidade. Este profissional será responsável por desenhar e implementar soluções robustas, garantindo a performance, escalabilidade e integridade do ERP, além de atuar como referência técnica para o time.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver, sustentar e otimizar rotinas complexas utilizando ADVPL e TLPP.
  • Arquitetar, implementar e sustentar integrações via APIs REST e Web Services para comunicação com sistemas externos, processos automáticos complexos JOBS e SCHEDULES.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código através de práticas de Code Review e aplicação de padrões de projeto (MVC, Orientação a Objetos).
  • Colaborar estrategicamente com as áreas de negócio para traduzir necessidades funcionais (Financeiro, Fiscal, Faturamento, etc.) em soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Promover a mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores Plenos e Juniores, disseminando boas práticas e novos conhecimentos.
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias em Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Linguagens : Domínio avançado em ADVPL e TLPP (Ênfase em classes e REST).
  • Arquitetura: Experiência sólida em Orientação a Objetos e integrações REST/SOAP.
  • Ambiente escalável de alta demanda (Jobs/Schedules com multi-thread)
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento profundo em SQL Server ou Oracle (Queries, Procedures e Tuning).
  • Gestão de Código: Experiência com ferramentas de controle de versão (Git, GitLab ou Azure DevOps).
  • Testes Unitários / TDD: Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Front-end com PO-UI (Angular).
  • Experiência com Protheus em ambiente Cloud.
  • Conhecimento funcional avançado nos módulos principais (SIGAEST, SIGAPCP, SIGAFIS, SIGAFAT, SIGAFIN, SIGAGPE entre outros).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD aplicadas ao Protheus.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: Analista de Controladoria Sr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Controladoria Sr em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e consolidar o orçamento anual da área comercial, bem como prestar suporte na elaboração do orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing.
  • Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio.
  • Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva.
  • Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira.
  • Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio.
  • Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix.
  • Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).
  • Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.
  • Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.
  • Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.
  • Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.
  • Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.
  • Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.
  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.
  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh .
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Senior Workday Financials Consultant
description:

About the job


As a Senior Workday Financials Consultant at Aspire, you will support the Finance Solution Delivery team in configuring, maintaining, and enhancing Workday Financials. You will work across multiple financial domains, handling both production support and project-based work, while partnering with Finance stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable solutions. This role requires strong autonomy, problem-solving skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, lean team environment.

What you’ll do

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Workday Financials.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday.
  • Experience supporting both production support and project-based implementations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and systems thinking skills.
  • Proven experience across multiple Financials domains, especially: Financial Accounting (top priority), Expenses, Business Assets, Banking & Settlement (secondary)
  • Experience with Workday Accounting Center and/or Prism is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Workday integrations and reporting is a plus.
  • Exposure to Workday Orchestrations or automation frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage directly with business stakeholders.
  • Experience working in lean, high-performing teams with broad ownership responsibilities.

title: Client Support and Administrative Assistant, Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Client Support and Administrative Assistant, Remote em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position: 

Bilingual Administrative and Client Communication Assistant, Remote 


Job Overview:

We are looking for a Client and Administrative Assistant to join our residential cleaning company based in California, USA. This is a long-term, stable remote position, not a temporary project.

Internal communication is in Portuguese, and client communication is in English. This role is a good fit for someone who is continuing to build their professional experience, communicates clearly and professionally in English, enjoys organization, is detail-oriented, and wants stability in a small, well-organized business. 


Working Hours:

The standard schedule is 30 hours per week, Monday through Friday.

Optional: up to 2 Saturdays per month.


Two schedule options:


Morning schedule:

Starts at 7:30am Pacific Time (US), equivalent to 11:30 Brazil time. The ideal schedule is 6 hours per day, though the end time can be slightly flexible depending on availability. 


Afternoon schedule:

12pm to 6pm Pacific Time (US), equivalent to 16:00 to 22:00 Brazil time.


Type of contract:

Independent Contractor, Brazilian MEI. 


Requirements

  • Strong English writing skills are required, since most client communication is handled by email and text. You should also feel comfortable speaking with clients by phone when needed. 
  • Basic Spanish for simple communication. You do not need to be fluent. 
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace tools, including Docs, Sheets, and Drive. 
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection, a high-quality headset with voice isolation, and an interruption-free workspace during working hours. 


Responsibilities:

  • Provide customer support through email and text, while communicating with clients clearly and professionally.
  • The role also includes occasional phone calls in English, mainly to handle initial inquiries, ask screening questions, and share service information. This is not a cold-calling or outbound sales position. 
  • Keep client information, appointments, notes, and related records organized.
  • Communicate with the cleaning team in Spanish for basic day-to-day updates. 


Compensation:

Compensation is paid in Brazilian reais. Please include your salary expectation when applying. 


To apply:

Please send your resume, your preferred schedule option, your salary expectation in Brazilian reais, and  a  short 1 to 2 minute video in English sharing a little about your professional experience to .

title: UX Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para UX Writer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A posição é responsável por planejar e produzir conteúdos que otimizem a experiência da pessoa usuária e gerem valor ao negócio por meio do texto. Atua estrategicamente em parceria com times de Design, Produto e Tecnologia, garantindo mensagens claras, concisas e orientadas à ação, mantendo a consistência do tom de voz e a escaneabilidade do microcopy.


Principais atribuições


  • Planejamento e execução de estratégias de UX Writing para diferentes produtos e projetos. Redação de textos instrucionais, informativos e engajadores com foco em jornada de produto. Condução de pesquisas primárias e secundárias (desk research, benchmark, entrevistas e surveys). Realização de testes de conteúdo para apoiar decisões de escrita e usabilidade.
  • Manutenção e atualização constante dos guias de redação e estilo da marca.
  • Colaboração com times multidisciplinares para garantir viabilidade técnica e de negócio nas entregas.
  • Análise de métricas de produto para identificação de melhorias contínuas no conteúdo textual. Defesa fundamentada de decisões de conteúdo junto a stakeholders.
  • Uso crítico de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para escala e revisão de conteúdo.

Requisitos


  • Experiência como UX Writer ou em posições similares de conteúdo digital.
  • Domínio avançado da Língua Portuguesa (gramática, redação e microcopy).

title: Senior AI Software Engineer (.NET + Agentic Workflows)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AI Software Engineer (.NET + Agentic Workflows) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

QAT Global, a 30+ years IT consulting firm headquartered in the US, is seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Software Engineer with strong .NET and Azure expertise and hands-on experience building AI-powered engineering workflows.

This position will work directly with US-based customers and distributed engineering teams across the US, Brazil, and Costa Rica.


About the Role

This is not a traditional backend development role.

You will help design, build, and operate AI-driven engineering workflows that automate software development activities using modern LLMs and agent frameworks. The role combines backend engineering, AI workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, and critical review of AI-generated code.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across both software engineering and applied AI domains — building automation while also validating and improving generated outputs.

This is an international environment, and the position is collaborative and technically strong.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain AI-assisted development workflows for .NET applications
  • Build integrations between LLMs, internal tooling, and engineering platforms
  • Create and refine prompts, templates, structured outputs, and agent behaviors
  • Review, validate, and improve AI-generated .NET code and pull requests
  • Develop automation around Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling
  • Build evaluation and verification mechanisms for AI-generated outputs
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to follow enterprise standards and patterns
  • Debug and optimize agent execution flows, tooling integrations, and orchestration logic
  • Contribute to platform reliability, observability, and operational efficiency


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and Entity Framework
  • Strong Azure Cloud experience, including services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Managed Identities, etc.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps
  • Ability to read and interpret technical and architectural documentation
  • Hands-on experience working with modern LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, or similar
  • Working proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, or AI workflows
  • Experience with prompt engineering and AI workflow design
  • Familiarity with at least one modern AI/agent framework, such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, and similar frameworks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Advanced English communication skills


Nice to Have

  • Experience with developer tooling or engineering automation
  • AI-assisted code generation or PR automation experience
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Experience with vector databases or RAG architectures
  • Observability or evaluation frameworks for AI systems
  • Experience with Blazor or legacy .NET Framework applications
  • Exposure to prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, or LLM testing strategies


What We Are Looking For

We are looking for engineers who:

  • enjoy solving complex technical problems;
  • are comfortable working with emerging AI technologies;
  • can balance engineering quality with experimentation;
  • have a hands-on mindset;
  • can critically evaluate AI-generated outputs rather than blindly trusting them.

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: SAP Solution Architect (Basis / Hyperscaler)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP Solution Architect (Basis / Hyperscaler) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na NTT DATA Business Solutions, impulsionamos a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e além, impulsionados por uma equipe global e mais de 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 nações em mais de 30 países. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas e para suas pessoas.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede.


Make this the place where you grow!


Buscamos um(a) SAP Solution Architect com sólida experiência técnica em SAP Basis, certificação SAP PCA e atuação como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em ambientes hyperscaler certificados, para apoiar projetos estratégicos de System Move, Migration e Upgrades, além de iniciativas de pré‑vendas. Esse profissional será responsável por definir, validar e governar arquiteturas técnicas SAP em ambientes on‑premise, cloud e híbridos, assegurando viabilidade técnica, segurança, performance, escalabilidade e total aderência às melhores práticas e recomendações oficiais da SAP.


Principais Responsabilidades:



  • Definir e desenhar arquiteturas técnicas SAP para projetos de:
  • System Move (on‑premise ↔ cloud / datacenter); System Migration (ECC para S/4HANA, conversões técnicas e transformações de landscape); Upgrades SAP (tecnológicos e funcionais).
  • Atuar como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em hyperscalers certificados SAP, garantindo conformidade com padrões de:
  • Disponibilidade; Segurança; Performance; Escalabilidade.
  • Exercer o papel de arquiteto técnico e referência SAP Basis em projetos SAP de média e alta complexidade.
  • Apoiar processos de pré‑vendas, incluindo:
  • Análise de requisitos técnicos; Definição da arquitetura de solução;
  • Avaliação de riscos, premissas e dependências técnicas; Estimativas de esforço e definição da abordagem técnica;
  • Participação em reuniões com clientes e apresentações executivas.
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos relacionados a:

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DevOps Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DevOps Engineer:


We are looking for a full-time, remote DevOps Engineer with 3 to 5 years of work experience to work with our U.S. client. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing highly secure, scalable, and reliable cloud platform solutions on AWS. You will collaborate with the Head of DevOps and other technical leaders to build and maintain infrastructure, automation, monitoring, and security processes. Additionally, you will play a key role in supporting ISO 27001 / ISMS / SOC2 Type II compliance efforts.


This role requires strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. While an infrastructure background is beneficial, you should also be comfortable writing scripts and basic software code to enhance and streamline operations.


Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, building new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and the Australia / New Zealand markets.


Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with the Head of DevOps to define detailed technical requirements, plan work, and prioritize tasks according to business needs
  • Design, implement, and maintain AWS cloud platform solutions
  • Ensure strict security compliance and best practices in cloud infrastructure
  • Drive automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and system reliability
  • Strive for zero downtime when deploying solutions or services
  • Develop and own scalable processes for: Capacity planning, Configuration management, Monitoring, and observability
  • Provide day-to-day operational support and perform systems administration tasks
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support the platform 24/7
  • Ensure high-quality monitoring coverage for infrastructure and applications
  • Identify potential failure points in infrastructure and proactively develop mitigation strategies
  • Collaborate with internal IT teams for operational support
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type II security frameworks


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 3 to 5 years of DevOps experience
  • Strong AWS experience in infrastructure, security, and automation
  • Technical infrastructure knowledge across servers, storage, and networks
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Podman, etc.)
  • Experience with SQL
  • Comfortable working in high-security and high-compliance environments
  • Hands-on experience scripting and coding for DevOps automation
  • Experience in database administration, performance tuning, and resilience design
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts and best practices
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting for large distributed systems
  • Strong networking fundamentals (IP, traffic flow, network ports, protocols like HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, FTP)
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and drive resolution
  • Experience managing large-scale tasks from inception to completion
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles


Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, engineering, or related fields
  • Experience with automation tooling (e.g., HashiCorp products, configuration management tools)
  • Experience with automated testing in DevOps workflows
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), shift-left principles, and immutable infrastructure
  • Experience working in ISO 27001, PCI compliance, or SOC2 Type II environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient:

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Designer de Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco de talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer de Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco de talentos em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras.

Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
  • Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
  • Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.


Requerimentos & Skills:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero

FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.


We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.


The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.


About the Role

This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS.

You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.


What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

  • Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems.
  • Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient.
  • Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform.
  • Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities:


Full Stack Engineering

  • Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + TypeScript.
  • Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS.
  • Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.


AWS native Architecture

  • Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more.
  • Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.


Systems Integration

  • Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools.

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.


AI Forward Development

  • Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.

Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.


Collaboration & Impact

  • Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs.
  • Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning.
  • Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.


What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture.
  • Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation.
  • Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend).
  • Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams.
  • High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work.
  • Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.


Why Freight Hero

  • Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech.
  • Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes.
  • Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales.
  • Competitive compensation with performance incentives.
  • Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)


We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to support enterprise infrastructure automation and CI/CD modernization initiatives. This role will play a critical part in a large-scale migration to Harness, making hands-on Harness experience mandatory. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud platforms, automation, and DevOps best practices. This engineer will work closely with development, operations, and security teams to streamline deployments, improve reliability, and enhance operational efficiency across enterprise environments.


Key Responsibilities:

CI/CD Pipeline Development & Automation

  • Design, build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Harness, Jenkins, and other automation tools.
  • Lead and support migration efforts from legacy deployment tools and pipelines into Harness.
  • Implement deployment automation strategies to improve release speed, consistency, and reliability.Manage Git-based workflows and support DevOps best practices across engineering teams.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Automation

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform and related tools.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Support cloud environments including AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Ensure infrastructure scalability, security, and high availability across environments.

Containerization & Platform Engineering

  • Deploy and support containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Manage Kubernetes clusters, Helm charts, and cloud-native deployment strategies.
  • Support platform modernization and enterprise DevOps transformation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system architecture and deployment standards.

Monitoring, Security & Operational Support

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to ensure system reliability and uptime.
  • Support DevSecOps initiatives including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance automation.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance issues.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Maintain detailed technical documentation for infrastructure, pipelines, deployments, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA, and security teams to align DevOps strategies and standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership on DevOps best practices.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
  • Mandatory hands-on experience with Harness implementation and administration.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong expertise with Terraform, Jenkins, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration technologies.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or Groovy.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitOps workflows and version control best practices.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions.
  • Strong understanding of DevSecOps concepts and secure deployment practices.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins or other legacy platforms into Harness.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Terraform Associate, or Harness certifications are a plus.

description:

If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Confira esta oportunidade para MuleSoft L2 SME em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit Remote


Role Overview

MuleSoft Level 2 SME to provide advanced technical support, troubleshooting, and guidance for MuleSoft integration solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, API-led connectivity, and integration best practices. This role involves working closely with L1 support, development teams, and business stakeholders


Key Requirements

  • Strong experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform
  • Solid understanding of API-led connectivity
  • Expertise in troubleshooting and integration support
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams (L1 support, developers, business stakeholders)
  • Advanced English


Time Zone: US (Atlanta)

Shift: US Business Hours (6:00 PM – 3:30 AM IST)



Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software .NET
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Arquiteta de Software .NET em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.


O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica
  • Atuar diretamente em crises de produtos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções relacionadas à performance, escalabilidade ou estabilidade
  • Conduzir due diligence técnica de novas soluções, tecnologias, fornecedores e M&A
  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: .NET, Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Cloud & DevOps. Ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tipo de banco de dados. Ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, além de NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), etc.
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Observabilidade & Resiliência: Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, Circuit Breakers.
  • Ter capacidade de avaliar Segurança. Ex: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, gestão de secrets, compliance (LGPD/PCI-DSS).
  • Ter capacidade de utilizar as Metodologias: SCRUM/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, SRE, FinOps básico.
  • Ferramentas de documentação: ADR tools, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica
