title: Desenvolvedor de Software Java Senior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de Software Java Senior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga


Se você é um(a) desenvolvedor(a) Java experiente , com mais de 5 anos de prática e domínio de Java 8+ , esta vaga pode ser ideal para você.

Buscamos profissionais com base técnica sólida, espírito colaborativo e interesse em crescimento contínuo, que gostem de resolver problemas complexos e atuar em sistemas de alta criticidade.


Aqui na Bluesoft, a Inteligência Artificial já faz parte do desenvolvimento de software . Utilizamos ferramentas como OpenCode integradas ao fluxo de engenharia para acelerar tarefas, apoiar decisões técnicas e aumentar a produtividade.

Nesse contexto, o papel do desenvolvedor evolui: além de escrever código, você irá revisar, supervisionar e refinar soluções geradas por IA , garantindo qualidade, arquitetura, segurança e aderência às regras de negócio.


Se você gosta de desafios técnicos e quer atuar em um ambiente de alta performance e inovação, estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!


Nosso ambiente de trabalho

  • Metodologias ágeis
  • AWS como infraestrutura principal
  • CI/CD com Jenkins, Sonar e Docker
  • Repositórios no GitHub
  • IntelliJ IDEA (Ultimate)
  • Linux remoto e Mac no escritório

Desafios que você vai encontrar


  • Processamento de milhões de registros em alto volume
  • Alta concorrência e performance crítica
  • Processamento assíncrono de jobs
  • Tuning e otimização de sistemas existentes
  • Análise de logs, profiling e troubleshooting
  • Evolução de uma base de código extensa sem quebrar o legado


Tecnologias que você vai usar no dia a dia

  • Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring MVC
  • Hibernate
  • Oracle e PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript
  • Git
  • JUnit 5, Mockito
  • Selenide
  • AWS, Docker, Jenkins, Sonar
  • OpenCode / Codex / Claude Code (ou similares)


Uso ocasional

  • PL/SQL
  • MongoDB 4.4
  • Ionic com Vue.js (mobile)


Legado (manutenção)

  • JSP
  • AngularJS
  • jQuery


Conhecimentos desejáveis

  • Vue.js
  • Troubleshooting e análise de performance/logs
  • Otimização de SQL
  • Kibana / APM
  • Experiência com uso de IA no desenvolvimento

title: Product Design Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Design Lead em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garantir qualidade e consistência das entregas de design dentro da tribo;
  • Co-garantir, junto a PMs e Engenharia, que as entregas gerem valor para o cliente e impacto nos indicadores de negócio;
  • Identificar e priorizar oportunidades de experiência e produto em conjunto com GPM e PM;
  • Liderar a operação de design na tribo, reduzindo fricções e desalinhamentos entre squads;
  • Desenvolver designers através de feedbacks, direcionamento e acompanhamento contínuo;
  • Acompanhar discovery e delivery garantindo alinhamento entre estratégia e execução;
  • Promover alinhamento entre Design, Produto e Engenharia durante o desenvolvimento;
  • Contribuir para definição de critérios de qualidade e “Ready for Dev”;
  • Garantir previsibilidade e sustentabilidade operacional da atuação de design.


Requisitos e Qualificações

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

Se você é um(a) desenvolvedor(a) Java experiente , com mais de 5 anos de prática e domínio de Java 8+ , esta vaga pode ser ideal para você.

Buscamos profissionais com base técnica sólida, espírito colaborativo e interesse em crescimento contínuo, que gostem de resolver problemas complexos e atuar em sistemas de alta criticidade.

  • AWS como infraestrutura principal

  • Repositórios no GitHub

  • Análise de logs, profiling e troubleshooting

  • Hibernate

  • Redis

  • Ionic com Vue.js (mobile)


Legado (manutenção)

  • JSP
  • AngularJS
  • jQuery

  • Vue.js
  • Troubleshooting e análise de performance/logs
  • Otimização de SQL
  • Kibana / APM
  • Experiência com uso de IA no desenvolvimento

Python SR (Azure)

Location: Brazil

We are looking for a skilled Python Developer to join our team, with proven experience in building reliable applications in Azure environments. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and be familiar with core Azure services such as Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). title: Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Python Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Requirements added by the job poster

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

title: Estagiário(a) Jurídico
description:

Sua carreira com liberdade e propósito

Na Remessa Online, não se trata apenas de transferências internacionais, criamos conexões que rompem fronteiras e transformam realidades. Somos movidos pela ousadia, respeito, colaboração, encantamento e responsabilidade.


Nosso segredo? Trabalhar juntos com transparência, comprometimento e autonomia, sempre buscando a melhor solução. Estamos revolucionando o cenário financeiro global, e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!


Como vai ser o seu dia a dia

  • Auxiliar na organização e arquivamento de documentos, contratos e processos jurídicos;
  • Apoiar no envio de documentos para assinatura e validação de signatários em contratos e procurações;
  • Apoiar na elaboração e revisão de contratos, notificações, extratos e outros documentos legais sob supervisão;
  • Realizar pesquisas jurídicas, regulatórias e levantamento de jurisprudências;
  • Auxiliar no controle e atualização de prazos processuais e administrativos;
  • Participar da preparação de reuniões, organizando materiais e agendas;
  • Apoiar na comunicação com clientes internos, externos e demais partes envolvidas nas demandas jurídicas;
  • Colaborar com o time jurídico em atividades operacionais e administrativas do dia a dia.


O que você precisa saber para se juntar ao nosso time

  • Estar cursando a faculdade de Direito, em período noturno.
  • Conhecimento básico de informática (Pacote Office).
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Ser proativo(a), organizado(a) e com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e se adaptar a novos desafios.
  • Interesse pela área jurídica e disposição para aprender.


O que oferecemos

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico – Cobertura para você via SulAmérica.
  • VR flexível – Crédito no Caju para usar como quiser.
  • Descontos na Remessa Online – Para viver sem fronteiras!
  • Bem-estar e saúde – Consultas online com psicólogos e nutricionistas via Conexa Saúde e Psicologia Viva.
  • Wellhub – Acesso a academias e serviços como mindfulness, nutrição e terapia.
  • Day Off no Aniversário – Seu dia especial merece folga!



Atuação Remoto : Trabalhe de onde quiser! Se preferir um escritório, temos espaço em São Paulo. Flexibilidade é o nosso lema.


Diversidade e Inclusão: Construindo o Futuro!

Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece e nos impulsiona a ir além. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas! Queremos um ambiente onde cada voz seja ouvida, cada experiência valorizada e cada contribuição faça a diferença.

Mais do que um compromisso, essa é a nossa realidade: um lugar acolhedor, respeitoso e representativo, onde juntos construímos um futuro mais justo, inclusivo e inspirador.

Vem ser #SouRemessa e fazer parte da equipe que transforma o mundo com ousadia, colaboração e responsabilidade!

title: Desenvolvedor Python
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Python em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Python Developer, who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will

Backend & APIs

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI or Django REST Framework) to support workflows for registering operations and results.
  • Model and manage relational databases (PostgreSQL) with a focus on traceability and historical integrity.
  • Ensure service performance, security, and scalability.
  • Develop integrations with external platforms via APIs.


AI Agents & LLMs

  • Integrate calls to language models (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) to support operational decision‑making.
  • Implement Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using the Trading Desk’s historical operations data.
  • Ensure explainability and traceability of recommendations generated by AI agents.


Data Engineering

  • Build data ingestion and transformation pipelines for operational data (ETL/ELT).
  • Define data entities (opportunities, strategies, market parameters) to support continuous analysis.
  • Support the creation of dashboards and reports to assess strategic effectiveness.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance.


Mandatory Skills

  • +5 years of experience
  • Backend: Solid experience with Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django).
  • Data: Experience with relational modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and advanced SQL.
  • AI: Experience integrating LLMs and agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen).
  • Architecture: Familiarity with REST API design and software best practices.
  • Infrastructure: Experience with PostgreSQL.
  • Language: Technical English for reading documentation.


Desirable Skills

  • Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).

description:

Descrição da Vaga

Atuar na linha de frente do suporte, sendo o ponto focal para nossos usuários internos. O objetivo é garantir a continuidade dos negócios, assegurando que o ambiente de trabalho (físico e lógico) esteja sempre disponível e produtivo. Você será o guardião da experiência do usuário, tratando cada chamado com o senso de urgência e a qualidade que nossos clientes internos exigem.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Operação e Atendimento (Sustentação)

  • Gestão de Chamados: Atuar no atendimento via sistemas de gestão (GLPI, Jira), respeitando rigorosamente os níveis de serviço (SLAs) e prazos de resolução.
  • Multicanalidade: Prestar suporte técnico ágil e eficiente através de diferentes vias: presencial, telefone, vídeo conferência e chats.
  • Manutenção de Hardware: Executar instalação, desinstalação, configuração e formatação de estações de trabalho (desktops/notebooks).
  • Manutenção Preventiva: Realizar a limpeza física e verificação de periféricos, incluindo impressoras e acessórios, garantindo a longevidade dos equipamentos e evitando falhas.

2. Infraestrutura e Software

  • Software: Instalação, atualização e suporte a softwares, com foco em Pacote Office 365 e sistemas legados/ERP (TOTVS).
  • Redes: Diagnóstico e suporte básico de conectividade (rede local, Wi-Fi e VPN).
  • Gestão de Inventário: Organizar e controlar o estoque de ativos (TI), garantindo a integridade dos equipamentos e auxiliando na gestão eficiente de recursos.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Formação: Ensino Técnico em TI completo ou cursando/graduado em áreas correlatas (Sistemas de Informação, Redes, Ciência da Computação).
  • Domínio Técnico:
  • Experiência com ferramentas de chamados (GLPI, Jira).
  • Conhecimento prático em ERP (TOTVS) e ecossistema Microsoft (Windows/Office 365).
  • Vivência em montagem, configuração e manutenção física/lógica de computadores.
  • Noções básicas de redes (TCP/IP, impressoras, DNS).

Perfil Comportamental

  • Senso de Urgência & Organização: Entender que o tempo do usuário parado é um custo para a empresa; capacidade de priorizar demandas críticas.
  • Olhar de Dono: Zelo pelo patrimônio, cuidado com o estoque e proatividade para sugerir melhorias contínuas.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Excelente escrita e fluência verbal para atendimento ao cliente.
  • Empatia: Capacidade de ouvir, compreender a frustração do usuário e prestar um atendimento humano e prestativo.

title: Analista Contábil Fiscal Jr.
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Contábil Fiscal Jr. em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Já pensou em trabalhar em um grupo eleito como a 86ª startup mais promissora do Brasil ?


A Conface Contabilidade , empresa da Dreamland Holding (que também inclui a Dream Success), está em busca de um(a) Analista Contábil Fiscal Jr. para integrar o time.


Essa é uma oportunidade para contadores que desejam crescer em uma contabilidade reconhecida pelo modelo inovador e por um atendimento verdadeiramente humanizado .


Para nós, contabilidade não é apenas enviar tributos para o cliente todos os meses. É fazer parte da vida do empreendedor , ajudando-o a crescer e tomar decisões estratégicas.


Responsabilidades (Fiscal & Contábil)


  • Apuração de impostos : ISS, ICMS, IPI, IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS.
  • Obrigações acessórias : EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, ECD , ECF, DCTF, EFD-Reinf e DEFIS (e DIRF quando exigida pela legislação vigente).
  • Acompanhamento das mudanças do IVA (Imposto sobre Valor Adicionado) que passam a vigorar a partir do próximo ano.
  • Fechamento contábil autônomo : conciliações, provisões, classificação contábil, balancetes, Balanço e DRE .
  • Relatórios gerenciais e indicadores das empresas da carteira.
  • Atendimento consultivo a clientes para dúvidas técnicas (fiscal e contábil).
  • Demais atividades inerentes ao cargo.


Requisitos


  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (concluída ou em andamento).
  • CRC ativo (obrigatório e deve constar no currículo enviado para conferência ).
  • Experiência anterior na função fiscal/contábil em escritório de contabilidade.
  • Conhecimento de Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional .
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (principalmente Excel ).
  • Sistema Domínio : conhecimento prático e comprovado (eliminatório).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de dono e comunicação clara em ambiente remoto.


Nossa cultura


Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega .

Valorizamos profissionais que desejam ter direitos respeitados , mas que também entendem que nossa empresa preza por meritocracia e comprometimento .


Não seguimos a chamada “cultura do mimimi”.

Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho , onde quem se dedica, cresce.


Benefícios


  • Vaga 100% remota — Acreditamos de verdade no Home Office. Mas com monitoramento de performance por metas e entregas claras. Utilizamos um programa chamado Jibble, para controle de trabalho remoto.
  • Gestão humanizada — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é ️‍ . Para nós humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro.
  • Day-off no aniversário — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar.
  • Feedbacks trimestrais estruturados através do nosso Comitê de Pessoas — Significa que você tem chance real de ser promovido a cada 3 meses , conforme seu desempenho.
  • Caju Benefícios Flexíveis — Disponibilizamos R$600 por mês para você utilizar em benefícios flexíveis.
  • Rapidoc — Acesso ao maior hub de saúde corporativa digital do Brasil. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pago 100% pela nossa empresa.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento — Investimos no seu crescimento com cursos pagos pela empresa.
  • Adicional no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios para trabalho remoto — Afinal respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e vamos te pagar pela utilização dos mesmos, caso necessário.


Como se candidatar


  • Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e mantenha seu currículo atualizado , mandatóriamente em PDF.
  • É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo conste no currículo para validação.
  • Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).
  • Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Abril/26.


Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

title: Consultor Abap - Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor Abap - Pleno em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP Pleno para integrar nosso time e atuar em projetos e sustentação SAP S/4HANA, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento, manutenção e otimização de soluções customizadas, garantindo qualidade, performance e aderência às melhores práticas SAP.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na sustentação do cliente através de atendimento de chamados e suporte técnico.
  • Desenvolver e manter programas, relatórios, interfaces, formulários e melhorias em SAP S/4HANA.
  • Criar especificações técnicas com base em requisitos funcionais fornecidos pelas áreas.
  • Atuar em integrações SAP com sistemas internos e externos (ex.: EDI, APIs, Web Services).
  • Apoiar testes unitários, integrados e homologação (SIT/UAT).
  • Garantir conformidade com padrões de qualidade e governança de código.
  • Apoiar na resolução de incidentes e análise de performance.
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento técnico e acompanhamento de demandas.
  • Produzir documentação técnica e relatórios de status.
  • Atuar em conjunto com consultores funcionais e áreas de negócio para entendimento e execução das demandas.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP ABAP.
  • Experiência com Reports, SmartForms, Enhancements, BADIs e BAPIs.
  • Conhecimento em ABAP OO, CDS Views, Fiori e integração com SAP Gateway.
  • Experiência com interfaces IDoc, RFC, Web Services e OData.
  • Atuação anterior em AMS SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento e manutenção de objetos customizados SAP.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e ferramentas como ServiceNow.
  • Boa capacidade analítica, organização e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em integrações SAP com sistemas externos.
  • Vivência em ambientes SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimento em performance e otimização de código ABAP.
  • Experiência em projetos de sustentação e melhorias contínuas.


Modelo de trabalho

  • 100% Remoto

title: Portuguese Audio Recording
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Audio Recording em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At TRS Multilingual, we are looking for new team members to contribute to a project supporting the development of artificial intelligence speech and transcription models.


The process is simple: speak in Portuguese, record, and upload.


ABOUT THE PROJECT

This project supports the development of AI speech and transcription models. Your role is straightforward: record audio by speaking naturally in Portuguese on topics of your choice — such as storytelling, everyday conversations, or role-playing — and upload the recordings through a designated mobile application.


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Record audio in Portuguese on topics of your choice

• Upload recordings via the mobile application

• Complete tasks independently according to your own schedule


PROJECT DETAILS

• Contract Type: Freelancer / 100% Remote

• Ideal Availability: 2–5 hours per day (up to 40 hours per week)

• Recording Duration: 10–29 minutes per recording

• Pay Rate: $12.00 USD per hour


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Fluent spoken communication proficiency in Portuguese

• Access to a modern smartphone

• Fast and stable internet connection

• No prior experience required!

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Buscamos uma pessoa para liderar a modelagem conceitual do domínio em contexto industrial, conectando arquitetura de dados a necessidades de negócio. title: Mainframe Operations Support Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Mainframe Operations Support Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Mainframe Operations Support Specialist


Responsibilities

  • Provide full technology stack planning, administration, and support for Client's Mainframe environment, including z/OS, Db2, CICS TS, MQ, and ISV software
  • Monitor system health, schedule jobs (Autosys), and manage batch execution processes
  • Manage disk and tape systems including virtual tape libraries
  • Assist in ensuring Service Now CMDB is refreshed and updated so that it can be utilized for mainframe capacity planning
  • Perform incident management, change implementation, and recovery procedures
  • Administer mainframe security via RACF and perform regular performance tuning
  • Provide operational and disaster recovery support for mainframe environments
  • Manage software lifecycle, ensure compliance (NERC/CIP/SOX), and support application- and system-level tasks
  • Manages physical mainframe hardware, including vendor access
  • Execute diagnostics and support network configuration for mainframe component


Technologies/Tools

  • IBM z/OS
  • IBM RACF
  • IBM CICS
  • IBM MQ
  • Db2
  • ServiceNow

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Preferably to have relevant industry certification required.
  • Experience with mainframe operations and related system processes
  • Familiarity with infrastructure service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Proficiency in proactive system health monitoring and performance tracking tools
  • Advanced/ Fluent English

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software .NET
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Arquiteta de Software .NET em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.


O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica
  • Atuar diretamente em crises de produtos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções relacionadas à performance, escalabilidade ou estabilidade
  • Conduzir due diligence técnica de novas soluções, tecnologias, fornecedores e M&A
  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: .NET, Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Cloud & DevOps. Ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tipo de banco de dados. Ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, além de NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), etc.
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Observabilidade & Resiliência: Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, Circuit Breakers.
  • Ter capacidade de avaliar Segurança. Ex: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, gestão de secrets, compliance (LGPD/PCI-DSS).
  • Ter capacidade de utilizar as Metodologias: SCRUM/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, SRE, FinOps básico.
  • Ferramentas de documentação: ADR tools, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM


About the role

AI/R Company is a global ecosystem of technology and innovation that brings together companies specialized in digital transformation, software engineering, data, cloud, and artificial intelligence. The group includes well-known companies in the market such as Avenue Code and Compass UOL, working on strategic projects for major organizations worldwide.


With a strong international presence, AI/R Company connects talent and technology to accelerate digital transformation for its clients, fostering a collaborative, multicultural environment focused on continuous innovation.

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM to lead recruitment strategies for technical positions across different countries in Latin America. This person will be responsible for driving strategic hiring processes, supporting regional leadership in team expansion, and ensuring excellence in both candidate and internal stakeholder experience.


We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in international technical recruiting within IT consulting, strategic mindset, leadership capabilities, and a results-driven approach.

This role will have constant interaction with global stakeholders, technology leaders, and business areas, making strong communication skills, prioritization, and the ability to thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments essential.


Key responsibilities

  • Lead the LATAM Talent Acquisition team, fostering development, performance tracking, and best recruiting practices
  • Drive attraction and selection strategies for technical roles across various seniority levels and technologies
  • Actively manage international recruitment processes across Latin America and/or North America
  • Align hiring strategies with technology leaders, operations, and executive leadership
  • Ensure agility, quality, and predictability in recruitment processes
  • Conduct market mapping and develop sourcing strategies for highly specialized profiles
  • Monitor recruitment metrics and continuously improve funnel performance, SLA, conversion rates, and candidate experience
  • Structure and optimize recruitment processes, policies, and tools
  • Participate in global meetings and collaborate with international teams


Required qualifications

  • Strong experience in Talent Acquisition with a focus on technical recruiting
  • Previous experience in IT consulting or outsourcing companies
  • Proven experience leading recruitment teams
  • Strong background in international hiring, especially across LATAM
  • Experience recruiting roles such as Software Engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, Cloud, SAP, among others
  • Advanced or fluent English for interviews and meetings
  • Experience with active sourcing and talent attraction strategies
  • Analytical, organized, and metrics-driven profile


Nice to have

  • Intermediate or advanced Spanish
  • Experience with LATAM operations expansion
  • Experience in multicultural and high-volume environments
  • Knowledge of ATS systems, recruitment metrics, and TA automation
  • Experience working with global clients in the U.S. or Canada



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and compliance with the most rigorous data protection regulations worldwide, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. Candidates’ data will be kept confidential and used exclusively for recruitment purposes and may be shared with clients and companies within the Compass UOL Group involved in projects.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Java Senior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de Software Java Senior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga


Se você é um(a) desenvolvedor(a) Java experiente , com mais de 5 anos de prática e domínio de Java 8+ , esta vaga pode ser ideal para você.

Buscamos profissionais com base técnica sólida, espírito colaborativo e interesse em crescimento contínuo, que gostem de resolver problemas complexos e atuar em sistemas de alta criticidade.


Aqui na Bluesoft, a Inteligência Artificial já faz parte do desenvolvimento de software . Utilizamos ferramentas como OpenCode integradas ao fluxo de engenharia para acelerar tarefas, apoiar decisões técnicas e aumentar a produtividade.

Nesse contexto, o papel do desenvolvedor evolui: além de escrever código, você irá revisar, supervisionar e refinar soluções geradas por IA , garantindo qualidade, arquitetura, segurança e aderência às regras de negócio.


Se você gosta de desafios técnicos e quer atuar em um ambiente de alta performance e inovação, estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!


Nosso ambiente de trabalho

  • Metodologias ágeis
  • AWS como infraestrutura principal
  • CI/CD com Jenkins, Sonar e Docker
  • Repositórios no GitHub
  • IntelliJ IDEA (Ultimate)
  • Linux remoto e Mac no escritório

Desafios que você vai encontrar


  • Processamento de milhões de registros em alto volume
  • Alta concorrência e performance crítica
  • Processamento assíncrono de jobs
  • Tuning e otimização de sistemas existentes
  • Análise de logs, profiling e troubleshooting
  • Evolução de uma base de código extensa sem quebrar o legado


Tecnologias que você vai usar no dia a dia

  • Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring MVC
  • Hibernate
  • Oracle e PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript
  • Git
  • JUnit 5, Mockito
  • Selenide
  • AWS, Docker, Jenkins, Sonar
  • OpenCode / Codex / Claude Code (ou similares)


Uso ocasional

  • PL/SQL
  • MongoDB 4.4
  • Ionic com Vue.js (mobile)


Legado (manutenção)

  • JSP
  • AngularJS
  • jQuery


Conhecimentos desejáveis

  • Vue.js
  • Troubleshooting e análise de performance/logs
  • Otimização de SQL
  • Kibana / APM
  • Experiência com uso de IA no desenvolvimento

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Mainframe SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Mainframe SR em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa profissional em desenvolvimento Mainframe, para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações bancárias em ambiente IBM z/OS, utilizando COBOL, CICS, JCL, VSAM e DB2, com foco em estabilidade, segurança e performance.


Principais atividades:

  • Analisar, desenvolver e manter programas COBOL para processos batch e online.
  • Construir e sustentar transações CICS, incluindo telas BMS e integrações internas.
  • Escrever, otimizar e executar JCL para jobs batch, tratando abends e dependências.
  • Modelar, consultar e otimizar dados em VSAM e DB2 (SQL, índices, reorganizações).
  • Investigar e corrigir incidentes; apoiar testes (unitários, integrados, UAT) e promover entregas com conformidade bancária.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em ambiente de sistema bancário com COBOL, CICS, JCL, VSAM e DB2.
  • Domínio de processamento batch/online, controle de concorrência, transações e recuperação.
  • Vivência em tuning e troubleshooting: leitura de dumps e logs, performance de jobs e SQL.
  • Capacidade de levantar requisitos, estimar, desenhar soluções e documentar.
  • Atenção a normas de segurança, qualidade e compliance do setor financeiro.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Sr. Claude Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Claude Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Sr. Claude Developer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil or North America

Industry: IT & Services


Sr. Claude Developer | About You

As a Sr. Claude Developer, you are responsible for delivering high‑impact features in a fast‑moving, AI‑assisted development environment. You are deeply experienced in AI‑driven and agentic development workflows, using tools such as Claude and/or Cursor to significantly increase development speed, quality, and iteration velocity. You are comfortable with vibe coding, working fluidly with AI to explore solutions, refine implementations, and ship results quickly. You thrive in sprint‑based teams with clear deadlines, take ownership of complex workstreams, and consistently perform at a high output level. You are comfortable collaborating with distributed teams and ramping quickly on new codebases, tooling, and workflows.


Sr. Claude Developer | Day-to-Day

  • Build, refactor, and deliver production‑ready features using TypeScript in a modern application stack.
  • Leverage advanced AI coding tools (Claude and/or Cursor) as a core part of your daily development workflow, including agentic and iterative coding patterns.
  • Apply agentic development workflows to break down problems, generate solutions, validate approaches, and accelerate delivery.
  • Work within sprint cycles, committing to scoped deliverables and consistently meeting assigned deadlines.
  • Deliver a high volume of story points per sprint, aligning with top‑tier performance benchmarks.
  • Collaborate closely with senior engineers and technical leadership to solve complex technical problems.
  • Review and improve existing code while maintaining performance, readability, and scalability.
  • Participate in technical discussions and help shape best practices for AI‑assisted and agentic development.


Sr. Claude Developer | Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in software development, engineering, or a closely related role, delivering production‑ready applications in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong, hands‑on fluency with TypeScript, including building and maintaining scalable, maintainable code within modern application architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic development workflows, using AI to plan, iterate, validate solutions, and accelerate engineering tasks from end‑to‑end.
  • Recent, dedicated experience using Claude and/or Cursor at an advanced level, leveraging these tools for high‑velocity, high‑quality development beyond basic code generation.
  • Comfortable with vibe coding, working interactively with AI to explore approaches, refine implementations, and quickly converge on production‑ready outcomes.
  • Proven ability to deliver high output in sprint‑based development environments, consistently meeting or exceeding expectations for scoped work and story point delivery.
  • Fluent or very strong English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross‑functional teams.

About the role

AI/R Company is a global ecosystem of technology and innovation that brings together companies specialized in digital transformation, software engineering, data, cloud, and artificial intelligence. The group includes well-known companies in the market such as Avenue Code and Compass UOL, working on strategic projects for major organizations worldwide.

  • Strong background in international hiring, especially across LATAM
  • Experience recruiting roles such as Software Engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, Cloud, SAP, among others
  • Advanced or fluent English for interviews and meetings

Nice to have

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Python Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Requirements added by the job poster

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Engineering em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Director of Engineering (LATAM Based) - Remote - $175K Base


About the Company:


We are partnering with a fast-growing SaaS platform modernizing complex operational workflows for institutional financial services organizations. Their technology helps enterprise clients streamline onboarding, transaction management, compliance workflows, and stakeholder collaboration through a secure cloud-based platform.


The product is used by sophisticated organizations that require reliability, scalability, and high standards for security and operational excellence. They are focused on reducing operational friction and delivering a seamless digital experience in an industry traditionally dependent on manual processes.


The Opportunity:


We are seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead and scale a distributed engineering organization in a high-growth remote environment.


This role will oversee multiple engineering teams and front-line engineering managers across a globally distributed organization. The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who excels at building engineering culture, improving operational maturity, and helping teams execute effectively at scale.


You will work closely with executive leadership, product management, and architecture leadership to drive engineering execution, organizational development, and technical excellence.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and mentor engineering managers and technical leaders across multiple teams
  • Build a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement
  • Scale engineering operations through effective hiring, onboarding, organizational planning, and career development
  • Improve engineering processes, delivery predictability, and development workflows across teams
  • Partner with Product and cross-functional leadership to align technical execution with business priorities
  • Establish engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and platform reliability
  • Support organizational growth by developing future leaders and strengthening management capabilities
  • Drive alignment and communication across distributed engineering teams operating in multiple time zones
  • Help create a high-performing, inclusive, and transparent remote-first environment


Qualifications:


  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with significant engineering leadership responsibility
  • Proven experience managing managers and overseeing multiple engineering teams in a scaling organization
  • Strong background in Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and modern software engineering operations
  • Experience scaling distributed engineering organizations in remote or hybrid environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to balance technical quality, delivery execution, and organizational health
  • Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architectural and engineering decisions
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and executive leadership


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base salary: $175,000 USD
  • Fully remote - company HQ'd in the US
  • Opportunity to help shape engineering strategy during a high-growth phase
