title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

Uma pessoa curiosa, analítica e que goste de colocar a mão na massa, aprender na prática e contribuir com ideias e soluções para os projetos da área.


Aqui você terá:

title: Desenvolvedor júnior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor júnior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento de código e práticas CI/CD (Git);
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software/engenharia de software, da concepção à entrega;
  • Conhecimento dos principais Design Patterns;
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de desenvolvimento: SOLID, K.I.S.S, Clean Code;

Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento de arquitetura baseada a eventos, e serviços de mensageria;
  • Conhecimento de Docker e containers;
  • Conhecimento do espanhol;
  • Conhecimento em análise e aperfeiçoamento de performance de APIs;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Cloud Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atividades

• Realizar análise de custos em ambiente Cloud Azure.

• Atuar na gestão e alocação de custos Cloud.

• Criar previsões, tendências e planejamento financeiro relacionados ao consumo Cloud.

• Apoiar times de Engenharia, Projetos e Produtos na gestão financeira de recursos Azure.

• Atuar com governança e compliance financeiro em nuvem.

• Criar dashboards, relatórios e visualizações de dados para acompanhamento financeiro.

• Realizar análises detalhadas por serviço, região, produto, equipe ou centro de custo, mantendo rotinas contínuas de monitoramento de custos.

• Estruturar e manter modelos de rateio, garantindo associação correta de custos via tags, grupos de recursos e estruturas financeiras.

• Revisar taxonomias e sugerir melhorias de governança.

• Participar de reuniões de revisão de custos Azure com times de operações e liderança.

• Participar de comitês FinOps, governança e gestão orçamentária.

• Mapear oportunidades de savings para construção de planos financeiros anuais.

• Criar previsões de uso e gastos utilizando dados históricos, identificando tendências e sazonalidade de consumo.

• Avaliar impacto financeiro de novos projetos ou workloads e apoiar análises de ROI de iniciativas Cloud.

• Garantir aderência às políticas de tagging e governança de recursos.

• Construir dashboards, alertas e indicadores automatizados para acompanhamento técnico e financeiro.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

Conhecimento intermediário a avançado em Microsoft Azure, incluindo infraestrutura, serviços e tecnologias da plataforma.

• Experiência com Governança em Azure, contemplando:

  • Azure Cost Management
  • Azure Advisor
  • Azure Reservations
  • Azure Policies

• Conhecimento em estruturas de gerenciamento de recursos e organização de ambientes em nuvem:

  • Management Groups
  • Accounts/Subscriptions
  • Billing Groups

• Vivência em práticas de FinOps, incluindo:

  • Princípios da FinOps Foundation
  • Modelos de Showback e Chargeback
  • Alocação e rateio de custos em nuvem
  • Controle orçamentário e elaboração de forecast
  • Análise de custos por unidade de negócio, produto ou centro de custo
  • Interpretação de relatórios financeiros e operacionais

• Conhecimento em políticas de tagging, padronização e taxonomia Cloud.

• Experiência na criação de dashboards, relatórios gerenciais e visualização de dados.

• Certificações Microsoft Azure e/ou FinOps serão consideradas diferenciais.

title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

title: Maintenance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Maintenance Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Morgan Latif is an executive search and development consultancy focused on outcome-driven leadership hiring.


We partner with organisations across Medical Technology & Healthcare, Packaging, Chemicals & Speciality Materials, Consumer, and Industrial Technology to secure leaders who create measurable impact and long-term business performance.


Through deep sector expertise, rigorous assessment, and alignment to business objectives, we identify individuals who not only fit the role, but perform strongly and thrive within the organisation.


Job Title: Maintenance Manager

Company: Multi-national Mood Manufacturer


Position is based in Valencia, Spain and relocation would be supported should your application be successful.


We are working with a fast paced, Private-Equity backed, Food Manufacturing business who is seeking someone with a strong drive for process optimization , CMMS implementation , and leading a maintenance team of approximately 20 people .


The role will involve leading and coordinating maintenance activities for a 24/7 continuous-process plant , managing and optimizing maintenance for process equipment, and driving the transition from reactive to proactive, reliability-based maintenance , including preventative and predictive strategies.


Fluency in both English and Spanish is essential for this role.


Candidate Profile:

  • Fluent English & Spanish speaker
  • Strong experience in process industries (mandatory), such as food, or paper manufacturing.
  • Proven background in reliability-focused maintenance within environments where maintenance strategies are already mature.
  • Ability to implement and sustain best practices in preventive and predictive maintenance.
  • High level of safety awareness, especially in energy-intensive and high-risk environments.
  • High level of Quality awareness linked with Food industry
  • Strong leadership and soft skills to drive cultural change and build trust and accountability.
  • Experience managing complex maintenance organizations and driving data-driven decision-making.
  • Comfortable working with new equipment and establishing KPIs (e.g., MTBF still to be defined due to new machinery).


KPI:

  • Asset reliability / up time (OEE improvement)
  • Reduction of unplanned downtime
  • Preventive vs reactive maintenance ratio
  • Safety, food safety & compliance
  • Maintenance cost vs downtime cost optimization


If you feel up to for a challenge and thrive in a dynamic environment, we look forward to receiving your application!

title: .NET Core Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para .NET Core Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

.NET Core Developer (Containerization & Application Support)

Remote

Contract


Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled and hands-on .NET Core Developer with strong experience in containerized application development and deployment. The ideal candidate will be responsible for enhancing existing .NET applications, supporting container-based deployments, and assisting internal teams with troubleshooting and optimization of containerized environments.

This role requires a strong development background combined with practical experience working with modern container technologies and cloud-native application practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain applications using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core
  • Develop and implement updates, enhancements, and bug fixes for existing .NET applications
  • Build, manage, and support containerized applications using Docker and related technologies
  • Assist internal teams with deployment, troubleshooting, and operational support for container-based applications
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to application performance, container orchestration, and deployment pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps, Infrastructure, QA, and Product teams
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development best practices
  • Support CI/CD pipeline integration and deployment automation efforts
  • Monitor application stability, scalability, and reliability in containerized environments
  • Document technical designs, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting steps


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong experience in .NET Core / ASP.NET Core development
  • Proficiency in C# and modern backend development practices
  • Hands-on experience with container technologies such as Docker
  • Experience troubleshooting and supporting containerized applications in production environments
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms
  • Experience with REST APIs, microservices architecture, and distributed systems
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Knowledge of Git and version control best practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure or AWS
  • Exposure to AKS, EKS, or OpenShift environments
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools for containerized applications
  • Experience supporting enterprise application deployments
  • Understanding of infrastructure automation and scripting

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

  • Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro.

  • Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing.
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.

Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday

If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in retail.


Key Responsibilities


  • Collaborates and pairs with other product team members (UX, engineering, and product management) to create secure, reliable, scalable software solutions
  • Writes custom code or scripts to automate infrastructure, monitoring services, and test cases
  • Writes custom code or scripts to do \"destructive testing\" to ensure adequate resiliency in production
  • Creates meaningful dashboards, logging, alerting, and responses to ensure that issues are captured and addressed proactively
  • Contributes to enterprise-wide tools to drive destructive testing, automation, or engineering empowerment
  • Identifies product enhancements (client-facing or technical) to create a better experience for the end users
  • Identifies unsecured code areas and implements fixes as they are discovered with or without tooling
  • Contributes to foundational code elements that can be reused many times by a product
  • Contributes to meaningful architecture diagrams and other documentation needed for security reviews or other interested parties
  • Defines Service Level Objectives for product(s) to constantly measure their reliability in production and help prioritize backlog work



Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience with Java 11 or above
  • Experience and understanding of what Lambda Expressions and Streams are in Java 8
  • SQL experience (BigQuery)
  • Understanding of ML concepts
  • Experience using Spring Boot
  • Must have experience developing microservices with Spring Boot
  • Experience developing applications that are hosted in the cloud – client uses GPC, but open to AWS or Azure experience
  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience writing Junit test cases
  • 2+ years’ experience working in an Agile environment in 2 week sprints
  • Advanced English required



Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• CLT hiring model + benefits

• International team environment

title: Business Operations Sr Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Operations Sr Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.


Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.


Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Maintenance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Maintenance Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Morgan Latif is an executive search and development consultancy focused on outcome-driven leadership hiring.


We partner with organisations across Medical Technology & Healthcare, Packaging, Chemicals & Speciality Materials, Consumer, and Industrial Technology to secure leaders who create measurable impact and long-term business performance.


Through deep sector expertise, rigorous assessment, and alignment to business objectives, we identify individuals who not only fit the role, but perform strongly and thrive within the organisation.


Job Title: Maintenance Manager

Company: Multi-national Mood Manufacturer


Position is based in Valencia, Spain and relocation would be supported should your application be successful.


We are working with a fast paced, Private-Equity backed, Food Manufacturing business who is seeking someone with a strong drive for process optimization , CMMS implementation , and leading a maintenance team of approximately 20 people .


The role will involve leading and coordinating maintenance activities for a 24/7 continuous-process plant , managing and optimizing maintenance for process equipment, and driving the transition from reactive to proactive, reliability-based maintenance , including preventative and predictive strategies.


Fluency in both English and Spanish is essential for this role.


Candidate Profile:

  • Fluent English & Spanish speaker
  • Strong experience in process industries (mandatory), such as food, or paper manufacturing.
  • Proven background in reliability-focused maintenance within environments where maintenance strategies are already mature.
  • Ability to implement and sustain best practices in preventive and predictive maintenance.
  • High level of safety awareness, especially in energy-intensive and high-risk environments.
  • High level of Quality awareness linked with Food industry
  • Strong leadership and soft skills to drive cultural change and build trust and accountability.
  • Experience managing complex maintenance organizations and driving data-driven decision-making.
  • Comfortable working with new equipment and establishing KPIs (e.g., MTBF still to be defined due to new machinery).


KPI:

  • Asset reliability / up time (OEE improvement)
  • Reduction of unplanned downtime
  • Preventive vs reactive maintenance ratio
  • Safety, food safety & compliance
  • Maintenance cost vs downtime cost optimization


If you feel up to for a challenge and thrive in a dynamic environment, we look forward to receiving your application!

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in retail.


Key Responsibilities


  • Collaborates and pairs with other product team members (UX, engineering, and product management) to create secure, reliable, scalable software solutions
  • Writes custom code or scripts to automate infrastructure, monitoring services, and test cases
  • Writes custom code or scripts to do \"destructive testing\" to ensure adequate resiliency in production

Required Qualifications

  • Experience and understanding of what Lambda Expressions and Streams are in Java 8
  • SQL experience (BigQuery)
  • Understanding of ML concepts
  • Experience using Spring Boot
  • Must have experience developing microservices with Spring Boot
  • Experience developing applications that are hosted in the cloud – client uses GPC, but open to AWS or Azure experience
  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience writing Junit test cases

  • Advanced English required



Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• CLT hiring model + benefits

• International team environment

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Automation Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Business Operations Sr Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Operations Sr Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.


Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.


Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Automation Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Automation Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Company Description

FirstIgnite develops AI-powered tools designed to support universities. Our platform enhances efforts across Tech Transfer, Corporate Relations, Advancement, Career Services, and Research Development. By helping academic institutions grow, we empower them to achieve their goals and foster innovation. FirstIgnite is committed to providing cutting-edge solutions that bridge gaps between universities and the industries they serve.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Data Engineer. The Data Engineer will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, manage data architectures, and implement Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes. The role also involves analyzing and optimizing data systems while ensuring data integrity and supporting data-driven decision-making through effective data modeling and analytics.

Qualifications
  • Proficiency in Data Engineering, Data Modeling, and designing scalable data processes
  • Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes and Data Warehousing
  • Strong knowledge of Data Analytics and the ability to translate insights into actionable strategies
  • Familiarity with AI-driven or university-focused tools is a plus
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting while collaborating with cross-functional teams
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

title: Estágio em Direito
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Estágio em Direito em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo Iberostar estamos à procura de um estudante para atuar como Estagiário(a) de Direito para se juntar à nossa equipe em Salvador-BA (Brasil), para atuar em nosso Departamento Jurídico, sob supervisão direta da Diretoria Jurídica. Antes de saber mais sobre a vaga, achamos relevante compartilhar algumas informações sobre o Grupo Iberostar:


  • Somos uma empresa 100% familiar (mais concretamente, uma família de mais de 30.000 colaboradores).
  • Estamos presentes em 35 países e a nossa sede é em Palma de Maiorca.
  • Os nossos valores (Paixão, Responsabilidade, Transparência, Criatividade e Humildade) são muito importantes para nós e todas as nossas ações estão alinhadas com eles.
  • Somos pioneiros no turismo sustentável (veja o nosso movimento Wave of Change para saber mais).


Se isto lhe parece interessante... este pode ser o lugar certo para você! :)


Sobre a oportunidade:


O foco principal será a redação e controle de contratos em geral (obras, materiais, marketing e serviços). Além disso, o estagiário terá a oportunidade de auxiliar em todas as frentes da área, vivenciando o dia a dia de um departamento jurídico corporativo completo.


Quais serão suas principais funções?


  • Redação e controle de contratos modelo e demandas contratuais diversas.
  • Suporte em processos de regularização imobiliária e incorporação.
  • Auxílio no monitoramento de carteira de litígios (Cível, Consumidor e Trabalhista).
  • Apoio em demandas de Compliance, LGPD e implementação de políticas internas.
  • Suporte administrativo em atos societários e reuniões de alinhamento.


Requisitos:


  • Residir em Salvador ou RMS.
  • Estar cursando a partir do 5º semestre de Direito.
  • Conhecimentos básicos de informática.
  • Diferencial: conhecimento intermediário em espanhol (será valorizado devido à interface com a matriz).
  • Perfil proativo e com autonomia.


Alguns dos nossos benefícios:

  • Trabalhar em um ambiente inspirador que aposta nas pessoas, nos valores e em um modelo de turismo responsável.
  • Oportunidade de progressão dentro da empresa: uma variedade de oportunidades e projetos que permitirão desenvolver seu potencial, ampliar seus conhecimentos e construir uma trajetória de crescimento e desenvolvimento de carreira.
  • Bolsa-auxílio: R$ 1.850,00.
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido (4 dias em home office e 1 dia presencial no escritório comercial em Salvador).

title: Senior Data Engineer (Snowflake) - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer (Snowflake) - Relocation to Portugal em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.



What are we looking for?

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Senior Data Engineer or similar role, with a strong backend focus;
  • Deep expertise in Snowflake for data warehousing;
  • Extensive hands-on experience with dbt (data build tool);
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform is a plus;
  • Fluency in English (B2);
  • Williness to move to Portugal.



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: relocation to Portugal, mandatory. Will be hibrid in Portugal.



What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.



Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Especialista de Vendas e Marketing - Dispositivos Médicos, Equipamentos de Teste e Monitoramento em Saúde
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista de Vendas e Marketing - Dispositivos Médicos, Equipamentos de Teste e Monitoramento em Saúde em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1. Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de soluções, atendendo necessidades de equipamentos médicos, de saúde, industriais, infraestrutura, compras institucionais e projetos.

Diferente de plataformas tradicionais focadas apenas em listagem de produtos, a SolutionMall oferece suporte estruturado durante todo o processo de cooperação, incluindo entendimento das necessidades, recomendação de produtos e soluções, coordenação com fornecedores, apoio em RFQ, acompanhamento de cotações, coordenação de entrega e suporte de longo prazo para projetos.

No setor médico e de saúde, a SolutionMall pode apoiar necessidades relacionadas a:

  • Dispositivos médicos
  • Equipamentos de testes médicos
  • Equipamentos de teste em saúde
  • Dispositivos de monitoramento de pacientes
  • Equipamentos laboratoriais e de testes clínicos
  • Equipamentos de reabilitação e fisioterapia
  • Consumíveis médicos e materiais descartáveis
  • Equipamentos de apoio para hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios e centros de saúde
  • Saúde digital, gestão de saúde e sistemas de informação médica

2. Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Representante / Especialista de Vendas – Dispositivos Médicos, Equipamentos de Teste e Monitoramento em Saúde, Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento dos negócios médicos e de saúde da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

Esta é uma função flexível, baseada em cooperação comercial, adequada para profissionais que tenham recursos locais de clientes, relacionamento com canais, distribuidores ou experiência em desenvolvimento de negócios nos setores de dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de saúde, produtos laboratoriais, hospitais, clínicas, centros de diagnóstico ou equipamentos médicos.

O principal objetivo da função é desenvolver oportunidades locais, entender necessidades reais de compra, apoiar o acompanhamento de RFQs e cotações, e ajudar a SolutionMall a promover soluções de dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de teste em saúde e equipamentos de monitoramento no Brasil.

Esta não é uma função simples de venda no varejo. Trata-se de uma função B2B focada em hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, instituições de saúde, distribuidores e oportunidades de projetos de equipamentos médicos.

O candidato ideal deverá apoiar:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Comunicação com distribuidores e canais
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades de projetos
  • Coordenação de RFQ e cotações
  • Promoção de soluções médicas e de saúde
  • Feedback de mercado
  • Coordenação comercial
  • Avanço de projetos

3. Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolver clientes e canais locais no Brasil, incluindo hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, centros de diagnóstico, centros de reabilitação, distribuidores de dispositivos médicos, revendedores de equipamentos laboratoriais e contatos de compras em saúde.

Promover as soluções médicas e de saúde da SolutionMall, como dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de testes médicos, equipamentos de monitoramento de pacientes, equipamentos laboratoriais, produtos de reabilitação, consumíveis médicos e soluções digitais de saúde.

Apoiar a identificação das necessidades dos clientes, acompanhamento de RFQs, comunicação de cotações, seleção de produtos e avanço de oportunidades comerciais.

Coletar feedback do mercado brasileiro, incluindo demanda local, oportunidades de projetos, preferências dos clientes, preços, canais, concorrência e necessidades de pós-venda.

4. Qualificações

Requisitos

  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência em dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de saúde, equipamentos laboratoriais, monitoramento de pacientes, consumíveis médicos, equipamentos hospitalares ou vendas B2B de equipamentos médicos.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver clientes, distribuidores, instituições médicas ou contatos de projetos no Brasil.
  • Familiaridade com necessidades de clientes, RFQ, cotações e coordenação comercial.
  • Boa comunicação.
  • Proficiência profissional em português e inglês.

Diferenciais

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Especialista de Vendas e Marketing - Dispositivos Médicos, Equipamentos de Teste e Monitoramento em Saúde
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista de Vendas e Marketing - Dispositivos Médicos, Equipamentos de Teste e Monitoramento em Saúde em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1. Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de soluções, atendendo necessidades de equipamentos médicos, de saúde, industriais, infraestrutura, compras institucionais e projetos.

Diferente de plataformas tradicionais focadas apenas em listagem de produtos, a SolutionMall oferece suporte estruturado durante todo o processo de cooperação, incluindo entendimento das necessidades, recomendação de produtos e soluções, coordenação com fornecedores, apoio em RFQ, acompanhamento de cotações, coordenação de entrega e suporte de longo prazo para projetos.

No setor médico e de saúde, a SolutionMall pode apoiar necessidades relacionadas a:

  • Dispositivos médicos
  • Equipamentos de testes médicos
  • Equipamentos de teste em saúde
  • Dispositivos de monitoramento de pacientes
  • Equipamentos laboratoriais e de testes clínicos
  • Equipamentos de reabilitação e fisioterapia
  • Consumíveis médicos e materiais descartáveis
  • Equipamentos de apoio para hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios e centros de saúde
  • Saúde digital, gestão de saúde e sistemas de informação médica

2. Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Representante / Especialista de Vendas – Dispositivos Médicos, Equipamentos de Teste e Monitoramento em Saúde, Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento dos negócios médicos e de saúde da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

Esta é uma função flexível, baseada em cooperação comercial, adequada para profissionais que tenham recursos locais de clientes, relacionamento com canais, distribuidores ou experiência em desenvolvimento de negócios nos setores de dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de saúde, produtos laboratoriais, hospitais, clínicas, centros de diagnóstico ou equipamentos médicos.

O principal objetivo da função é desenvolver oportunidades locais, entender necessidades reais de compra, apoiar o acompanhamento de RFQs e cotações, e ajudar a SolutionMall a promover soluções de dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de teste em saúde e equipamentos de monitoramento no Brasil.

Esta não é uma função simples de venda no varejo. Trata-se de uma função B2B focada em hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, instituições de saúde, distribuidores e oportunidades de projetos de equipamentos médicos.

O candidato ideal deverá apoiar:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Comunicação com distribuidores e canais
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades de projetos
  • Coordenação de RFQ e cotações
  • Promoção de soluções médicas e de saúde
  • Feedback de mercado
  • Coordenação comercial
  • Avanço de projetos

3. Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolver clientes e canais locais no Brasil, incluindo hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, centros de diagnóstico, centros de reabilitação, distribuidores de dispositivos médicos, revendedores de equipamentos laboratoriais e contatos de compras em saúde.

Promover as soluções médicas e de saúde da SolutionMall, como dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de testes médicos, equipamentos de monitoramento de pacientes, equipamentos laboratoriais, produtos de reabilitação, consumíveis médicos e soluções digitais de saúde.

Apoiar a identificação das necessidades dos clientes, acompanhamento de RFQs, comunicação de cotações, seleção de produtos e avanço de oportunidades comerciais.

Coletar feedback do mercado brasileiro, incluindo demanda local, oportunidades de projetos, preferências dos clientes, preços, canais, concorrência e necessidades de pós-venda.

4. Qualificações

Requisitos

  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência em dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de saúde, equipamentos laboratoriais, monitoramento de pacientes, consumíveis médicos, equipamentos hospitalares ou vendas B2B de equipamentos médicos.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver clientes, distribuidores, instituições médicas ou contatos de projetos no Brasil.
  • Familiaridade com necessidades de clientes, RFQ, cotações e coordenação comercial.
  • Boa comunicação.
  • Proficiência profissional em português e inglês.

Diferenciais

  • Recursos existentes de clientes ou canais no Brasil.
  • Experiência com hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, centros de diagnóstico, distribuidores ou equipes de compras em saúde.
  • Experiência com RFQ, cotação, desenvolvimento de canais ou oportunidades de projetos.
  • Conhecimento do processo local de compras médicas e de saúde no Brasil.

5. Modelo de Trabalho

Esta função segue um modelo flexível de desenvolvimento de negócios baseado em cooperação.

As principais áreas de foco incluem:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Desenvolvimento de canais
  • Acompanhamento de RFQ e cotações
  • Comunicação de produtos e soluções
  • Coordenação comercial
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Apoio ao avanço de projetos

Para candidatos adequados, a SolutionMall poderá oferecer oportunidades de cooperação regional de longo prazo com base em recursos de clientes verificados, progresso de projetos e contribuição real.

Esta função é especialmente adequada para profissionais que já tenham experiência ou acesso a clientes nos setores de dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de teste em saúde, monitoramento de pacientes, equipamentos laboratoriais, equipamentos hospitalares ou canais de compras em saúde no Brasil.

6. Remuneração e Benefícios de Cooperação

A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de cooperação vinculado ao desempenho, baseado na contribuição real para os negócios, incluindo:

  • Resultados de desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Criação de oportunidades qualificadas
  • Progresso de RFQ
  • Avanço de projetos
  • Resultados de pedidos e negócios
  • Valor de cooperação de longo prazo

Os termos detalhados de cooperação poderão ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, considerando a experiência do candidato, recursos de clientes, capacidade regional, habilidade linguística, relacionamento com clientes e contribuição para projetos.

7. Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se com uma breve apresentação destacando sua experiência relevante em dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de saúde, equipamentos laboratoriais, monitoramento de pacientes, vendas B2B, RFQ, cotações ou desenvolvimento de clientes e canais no Brasil.

Você também pode enviar seu currículo atualizado para:

Application – Sales & Marketing Specialist – Medical Devices & Healthcare Equipment – Brazil
